en.headline: Jockey Club to pay HK$37.5 million in Asian Games bonuses
en.dek: More than 110 medallists will share the sum under the club's athlete incentive scheme, HK$5 million more than after Hangzhou.
body: The Hong Kong Jockey Club will pay HK$37.5 million in bonuses to more than 110 Asian Games medallists, RTHK reported on Sunday. The sum is HK$5 million higher than the payout after the Hangzhou Games.
The payments are made through the Jockey Club Elite Athletes Fund incentive scheme, after the Hong Kong delegation finished with 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze medals, 54 in all.

Club chief executive Winfried Engelbrecht-Bresges said the team had again shown performance, resolve and sportsmanship, and congratulated the medallists. He said the club had long supported both elite and community sport, including funding for the Hong Kong Sports Institute.

zh.headline: 馬會向亞運獎牌得主發放3750萬元獎金
zh.dek: 港台報道，超過110名獎牌得主將透過賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃分享這筆獎金，較杭州亞運多500萬元。
body: 港台周日報道，香港賽馬會將向超過110名亞運獎牌得主發放合共3750萬元獎金，較上屆杭州亞運多500萬元。
獎金透過「賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃」發放。中國香港代表團今屆取得11金19銀24銅，合共54面獎牌。
馬會行政總裁應家柏表示，代表隊再次以場上表現、堅毅鬥志和體育精神展現拼搏精神，並祝賀獎牌得主。他又指，馬會多年支持精英及社區體育，包括資助興建香港體育學院。
